metaTitle: Developer Tools - JSON Formatter, Base64, SHA-256 and Passwords | ReelFlow Toolkit
description: Format and validate JSON, encode or decode Base64, hash text with SHA-256 and generate a strong random password - all on your device.
ogTitle: Developer Tools - JSON, Base64, Hash and Passwords
ogDescription: Four everyday developer utilities that run entirely in your browser, with no uploads.
ldDescription: Format and validate JSON, encode and decode Base64, compute SHA-256 and SHA-1 hashes, and generate strong passwords in the browser.
lede: Four small utilities in one page: JSON formatter, Base64 encoder and decoder, SHA-256 hash and a strong password generator.

faq.q: Is my data sent to a server?
faq.a: No. Parsing, encoding and hashing all happen in the page. Nothing is logged and there is no account.
SHA-256 and SHA-1 through the browser's Web Crypto API. SHA-256 is the right choice for checksums and signatures; SHA-1 is included only for legacy comparisons.
Characters are picked with crypto.getRandomValues, the browser's cryptographic random source, and you choose the length and which character groups to include.
